results.reason: The lesson uses an open-book exam analogy familiar to Indian students and explicitly maps retrieval and generation to the analogy.
results.evidence: Think of an open-book exam. A closed-book student answers only from memory. An open-book student first finds the right page in the book, then writes the answer using that page. Finding the right page is retrieval. Writing the answer using that page is generation.
